reuse.why: Adds one guard next to the existing findOrCreateBank in link.ts and calls it from every provider link handler, using the tree's db.first helper.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only the five short call sites repeat the provider string and arguments, which is unavoidable given the per-provider handlers.

placement.why: accounts/link.ts already holds the shared linking helper (findOrCreateBank), so the new link-rule guard sits in the right module.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: A small, well-named, documented function with a single query; a new provider only needs one call.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link handlers in accounts/app.ts go through link.assertAccountNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the five call sites only pass their provider and ids.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
